resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners (GitHub Skills)

practice_tasks: Initialize a GitHub repository, commit a Python script implementing basic sorting algorithms, and push it.
Solve 5 easy array/string problems on LeetCode.
Review core concepts of matrices, derivatives, and basic probability.

resources.title: Kaggle Pandas & Intro to Machine Learning Courses

practice_tasks: Complete the Pandas and Intro to ML courses on Kaggle.

Run a pre-trained transformer model from Hugging Face for sentiment analysis.
Write an OpenCV script to load, grayscale, and resize an image.
Store a few text embeddings locally using Chroma DB.
Containerize a simple Python script using Docker.
Explore AWS console and review basic cloud deployment concepts for ML models.
